models.name: todo_list_users
models.description: Regular authenticated users who manage their personal todo lists. Users represent the primary user base of the application and have full control over their personal data within security boundaries. Each user can create, organize, and manage their own todo items.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: User's email address for authentication and account recovery. Must be unique across all users and follow valid email format.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for authentication. Never store passwords in plain text. Uses industry-standard hashing algorithms like bcrypt, argon2, or PBKDF2.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was created. Automatically set by the system during registration.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was last modified. Automatically updated whenever any profile information changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the user account was soft deleted. Null for active accounts. Enables account recovery and audit trails.

models.name: todo_list_user_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for regular users. Tracks user login sessions for security auditing and session management. Each session represents a distinct login from a specific device or browser.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: User who owns this session. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the user connected to establish this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session was created (user logged in).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the session ended or expired. Null for active sessions.

models.name: todo_list_admins
models.description: System administrators with elevated privileges for system management and user support. Admins are trusted personnel responsible for maintaining the system, supporting users, and monitoring overall application health. They have broader visibility into system operations while respecting user privacy.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Administrator's email address for authentication and system communications. Must be unique across all admins and follow valid email format.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Securely hashed password for admin authentication. Never store passwords in plain text. Uses industry-standard hashing algorithms like bcrypt, argon2, or PBKDF2.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Automatically set by the system during admin account creation.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last modified. Automatically updated whenever any admin information changes.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was soft deleted. Null for active accounts. Enables account recovery and audit trails.

models.name: todo_list_admin_sessions
models.description: Authentication sessions for system administrators. Tracks admin login sessions for security auditing and session management. Each session represents a distinct admin login from a specific device or browser with elevated privileges.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Administrator who owns this session. {@link todo_list_admins.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrator connected to establish this session.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: Connection URL where the admin session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led to the admin session creation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin session was created (admin logged in).

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin session ended or expired. Null for active sessions.

models.name: todo_list_todos
models.description: Todo items representing tasks that users want to track and manage. Each todo item is owned by a single user and contains the task information, completion status, and temporal metadata. This is the core business entity of the application, enabling users to create, organize, and complete their personal tasks.

foreignFields.name: todo_list_user_id
foreignFields.description: Owner of this todo item. {@link todo_list_users.id}

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Title of the todo item. A short, descriptive name for the task that users want to track. This is the primary text users see when viewing their todo list.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Extended details about the todo item. Allows users to add additional context, notes, or instructions about the task. Can contain multiple paragraphs if needed.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Completion status of the todo item. Valid values are 'complete' or 'incomplete'. Defaults to 'incomplete' when a new todo is created. Users can toggle this status at any time.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was first created. Automatically set by the system and cannot be modified by users. Used for sorting and organizing todos chronologically.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was last modified. Automatically updated whenever any property changes. Helps users track recent activity and modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the todo item was soft deleted. Null indicates the todo is active. When set, the todo is considered deleted but can potentially be recovered. Enables soft delete functionality for future recovery features.
